fact: Statistics Sierra Leone issued the Extended Second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (E-NSDS-II), extending NSDS II (2016-2020) so that NSDS III can be designed later to match the next national development plan; the document is dated November 2023.
A mid-term review of the second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS II) was carried out in 2018 and identified weaknesses in the Statistics Act.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSDS 2022-2025.
